card.title: A Necessary Heartbreak
card.instruction: Describe disappointment, rejection, or loss as the exact experience everyone needed in order to grow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm sorry I broke your graduation mug. Losing it is exactly how we learn to let go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That urge is why we needed this. We've confused a degree with a drinking vessel.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then give me your graduation mug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Losing mine will teach me generosity. We should both drink from jam jars tomorrow.

mechanism: A frames a broken graduation mug and the reciprocal surrender of A's own as necessary growth experiences.
confusable: Unlike excusing only harm to others, A must extend the growth interpretation when the loss reaches A.
comparison: D113-b agrees to give up the matching possession; D113-a keeps reframing material consequences as lessons.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
